newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - July 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - July 28.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Municipal affairs minister signs a 13.8 million riyal contract to construct concrete walls to prevent rocks from falling in the mountains surrounding the holy city of Mecca.
- Crown Prince Abdullah is to lay the foundation stone of the King Abdul Aziz Medical Centre in Jeddah on Tuesday.
- Sudan exports meat to Gulf Arab states worth $18 million annually.
- Saudi Arabia is to host a conference on the environment in Riyadh this year.
- Saudi businessmen are urged to post the names of their businesses in Arabic.
